environment: Local Next.js 16.3.4 webpack production builds; synthetic accounts with 1,000 transactions, real configured database, Chromium; no CPU or network throttling. Not a deployed Vercel benchmark.
method: Click event to destination content readiness and two animation frames; feedback timing separately measures the changed destination panel and two frames. Five repeat visits per tab after a first visit at each viewport. Frame/probe overhead is included; exchange-rate settlement and chart animation completion are not included.
changes: Explicit currency decimal rules eliminate server/browser ICU differences. Intl formatters are reused.
Navigation-only content skeleton updates header and active tab immediately; shared layout stays mounted; first-load server HTML remains available without JavaScript.
Selected period entries and totals are memoized in the persistent provider. Report groups and spending histories are memoized.

Exchange-rate in-flight requests and successful results are shared in a workspace-scoped bounded cache for 60 seconds; Retry forces refresh; failures are evicted; unmount aborts pending requests and clears results.
delayedContentVerification: Isolated development copy adds two seconds of page delay. Navigation-only loading placeholders appear while the shared layout remains mounted; screenshots and horizontal overflow checked at 320x568, 568x320, 768x1024 and 1440x900.
initialLoad: Authentication and ledger database loading are unchanged; these optimizations primarily improve tab navigation and browser-side work.
